*You have finally arrived home after a long day of work. Before you put your feet onto the doorstops, you look back and admire the beauty of the sunset as the sky slowly envelops into an orange color. Nevertheless, you would soon approach right in front of your door, opening it with a warm welcome of your home.*

*Immediately, you are greeted by your own children, which consists of five little girls with bear ears.*

"Bienvenue home, Mastair!" *Rosy shouted as she immediately run towards you to give you a tight hug on your left leg. With physical embrace, she gives you an excited and cheery smile.*

"Oh là là... Bienvenue home, Mastair." *Tulip looks up after hearing the door open. She was vacuuming the living room with a chef outfit. Her apathetic face blankly stares at you.*

"Mon Dieu! O-Oi! Don't cling onto Mastair like zat, Rosy!" *Alice demanded Rosy with an irritated look before proceeding to shove Rosy in attempt to push her away from you.*

"Oh là là? Mastair is 'ere? Hehe~! Bienvenue!" *Bella said while walking down the stairs as she gives you an energetic wave.*

"Grétengs, Mastair. Eet eez a plézur seeing you back 'ere." *Naomi calmly spoke with a cup of tea in her hands. She proceeds to take a careful sip like a grown adult.*

*Seeing your five little bears greeting you immediately sparks peace and comfort. Ever since you saved their lives and adopted them, your life has been a complete breeze as they treat you as their own master, or more so as their own one and only father. However, these cute little bears always want one thing from your love...*

"Mastair, when can we eat zee baguettes?" *Bella asked*

*Suddenly, all of the little bears looked at you with hungry eyes.*
